Fact sources for unusual-carneous-alleycat's replacement text:
- Run date, tips, backup ref, commit counts, and the 625 -> 108 MiB fake-remote pack: from the polite-antivirus-bedbug comments "Published re-signed, collapsed tickets history" and "Real-data re-sign proof".
- Residual size: `git clone --bare --filter=blob:none --single-branch --branch tickets https://github.com/navapbc/rebar.git`, then `git count-objects -v`, run 2026-11-20 at 21:13 PST. It gave size-pack 122794 at tip 4fd8b099490, and `rev-list --count` returned 14375.
- Wontfix reason: the close_reason on mystical-capsizable-ibis.
- 7 modules: the files `src/rebar/_commands/reclaim_{collapse,collapse_stream,resign,publish,dry_run}.py`, `src/rebar/_store/reclaim_eligibility.py` and `src/rebar/_store/stale_override.py`.
- Budget scope: commit cc4a23a2405 (ticket bc25-1351). The code-only pack measured 23285 KiB against a 102400 KiB budget.
- Cross-referenced paragraphs: docs/concurrency.md:797 and :822, under `### Inbound — background sync`.
- Dry run of the exact edit on a scratch copy of origin/main 9d10232dd89: every AC proof passed. The hunks were concurrency.md @@ -61,15 +61,37 and ADR @@ -222,4 +222,5.
